transcript.t: Today I will show you a simple dish: tomato and egg stir-fry. You need three tomatoes, four eggs, some oil and a little salt.
First, cut the tomatoes into small pieces. Then break the eggs into a bowl and mix them well.
Next, heat some oil in a pan. Pour in the eggs and stir them for one minute. Then take them out.
Heat a little more oil and put in the tomatoes. Cook them for three minutes until they are soft.
Put the eggs back into the pan and mix them with the tomatoes. Add salt, and it is ready.
This dish is sweet and sour, and children usually love it.
